summary: Cache unwired sidebar projections and plan against the projected model

schema.detail: No persisted or wire schema change.

compatibility.detail: V2 planning now requires an already projected complete tree, including pending overlays; every Rust caller is migrated and the implicit projection rebuild is removed. A single-entry cache keys scope, arrangement revision/version, membership epoch/frontier and catalog/presentation revisions, not unrelated snapshot writes. Hosts must advance revisions with changed inputs. The opt-in release scale harness reports cold projection p50/p95 separately and gates warm cache lookup, planning and pending-overlay update plus shared-widget render against 4ms/8ms and equivalent-work v1 baselines. This remains unwired; socket paging and sustained-write activation evidence still require D #4739.

manual.detail: No operator steps or configuration changes; the projection cache remains unwired.

recovery.detail: The in-memory cache adds no persisted state, migration, or runtime recovery requirements.
